question: top 5 pickup zones Jan 2024 count geojson
sql:
WITH jan_trips AS (
 SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
 FROM nyc_taxi_trips
 WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
 GROUP BY PULocationID
)
SELECT z.Zone, z.Borough, j.cnt, ST_AsGeoJSON(z.the_geom) AS geojson
FROM jan_trips j
JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = j.PULocationID
ORDER BY j.cnt DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Manhattan morning 8-9 pickup avg distance fare pax>=2 Jan
sql:
WITH trips AS (
 SELECT t.trip_distance, t.fare_amount
 FROM nyc_taxi_trips t
 JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID
 WHERE z.Borough = 'Manhattan'
 AND tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
 AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) BETWEEN 8 AND 9
 AND passenger_count >= 2
)
SELECT AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_distance, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare, COUNT(*) AS trips
FROM trips

question: trips >5km pickup dropoff Jan 2024 count
sql:
WITH zones AS (
 SELECT location_id, ST_Transform(the_geom,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m
 FROM nyc_taxi_zones
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_trips
FROM nyc_taxi_trips t
JOIN zones pu ON pu.location_id = t.PULocationID
JOIN zones do ON do.location_id = t.DOLocationID
WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
AND ST_Distance(pu.geom_m, do.geom_m) > 5000

question: boroughs unique dropoff zones tip > fare
sql:
WITH high_tip AS (
 SELECT DOLocationID
 FROM nyc_taxi_trips
 WHERE tip_amount > fare_amount
 AND tip_amount > 0
)
SELECT z.Borough, COUNT(DISTINCT z.location_id) AS unique_zones
FROM high_tip h
JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = h.DOLocationID
GROUP BY z.Borough
ORDER BY unique_zones DESC

question: trips origin within 2km Central Park Jan 2024
sql:
WITH park AS (
 SELECT ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.9654,40.7829),'EPSG:4326'),'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true) AS geom_m
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips_near_park
FROM nyc_taxi_trips t
JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID
JOIN park p ON TRUE
WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
AND ST_DWithin(ST_Transform(z.the_geom,'EPSG:4326','EPSG:3857',always_xy:=true), p.geom_m, 2000)

question: pickup zones >=3 rate codes list Jan 2024
sql:
WITH zone_rates AS (
 SELECT z.location_id, z.Zone, z.Borough, list(DISTINCT t.RatecodeID) AS rate_codes
 FROM nyc_taxi_trips t
 JOIN nyc_taxi_zones z ON z.location_id = t.PULocationID
 WHERE t.tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND t.tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
 GROUP BY z.location_id, z.Zone, z.Borough
)
SELECT z.Zone, z.Borough, r.ratecode
FROM zone_rates z, UNNEST(z.rate_codes) AS r(ratecode)
WHERE array_length(z.rate_codes,1) >= 3
LIMIT 100
